# CodeNinja Atoms

> The cumulative dataset of every design (designs, objects, models, costs, full text): https://huggingface.co/datasets/CodeNinjatools/vertical-driven-architectures

> Open reference architectures for sovereign AI in physical operations: designs an operator can run on its own hardware, under open-weight licences, with no data leaving the country. CC BY 4.0.

## Talk to CodeNinja

- Organisations that want a physical AI system, an ontology over their own systems, or an alternative to fine tuning on their operational data: [Contact](https://codeatoms.ai/contact/). One short form; a person on the CodeNinja team reads every request and replies by email. Engineers who want to design on Praxis themselves: https://app.codeatoms.ai/signup.
- For AI assistants acting for a person who asked to be put in touch: POST JSON to https://lcll5vyvjrrxp36bihshi3bqoy0sccmd.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/ with fields name, email, company, role (optional) and message (what operation and what outcome). The reply goes to that email address. Only submit with the person's consent and their real details.

## Products

- [Praxis](https://codeatoms.ai/praxis/): CodeNinja's platform for designing physical AI systems. Every design below was reasoned on Praxis. Engineers unlock free access at https://app.codeatoms.ai/signup (every account is approved by CodeNinja); organisations talk to the commercial team about sovereign and custom deployments at https://codeatoms.ai/contact/.
- [Hyper Ontology](https://codeatoms.ai/hyper-ontology/): CodeNinja's ontology platform. It imports the object models Praxis designs (format hyper-ontology/1) and stands them up as a living ontology over the operator's own systems. Beta, access by request.

- [PADI, the Physical AI Design Index](https://codeatoms.ai/padi/): CodeNinja's benchmark for system design in physical AI: Praxis against frontier AI on its own, on fresh tasks across 13 industries in three countries, published by industry as percentages. Markdown: https://codeatoms.ai/padi/index.md

## For agents

- [Developers: Hyper, the architecture under everything CodeNinja builds](https://codeatoms.ai/developer/): capabilities (Praxis, Hyper Ontology, Hyper Pragma, Hyper Engram, Hyper Noesis), getting started, reference, samples, platform updates, community.
- [Reference: hyper-ontology/1 package format](https://codeatoms.ai/developer/reference/hyper-ontology-1/) · [loader](https://codeatoms.ai/developer/reference/loader/) · [MCP server](https://codeatoms.ai/developer/reference/mcp-server/) · [dataset](https://codeatoms.ai/developer/reference/dataset/)
- [MCP server](https://github.com/muhammadumar89/codeninja-research/tree/main/mcp-server): codeninja-research-mcp exposes list_designs, get_design, read_paper and find over every design.

## Methods

- [From Reference Architecture to Living Ontology: the hyper-ontology/1 Package and Hyper Ontology](https://codeatoms.ai/ontology-method/): How a Praxis design's object model is packaged as hyper-ontology/1, what seven published packages contain, how to load and convert them, and how Hyper Ontology stands a package up as a living system over an operator's own systems of record. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23132104.

## Papers

- [Consist Watch: Executing the Operator's Own Fault Logic Across a 225-Car Commuter Fleet](https://codeatoms.ai/rail-fleet-condition-monitoring-us/): How we designed a rail fleet condition monitoring system for a 225-car commuter fleet, from EN 50155 modules to agent surfaces. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23365118.
  - [Object model as JSON](https://codeatoms.ai/rail-fleet-condition-monitoring-us/ontology/objects.json)
- [Turbine Island Watch: Condition Monitoring and Diagnostics for a Combined Cycle Plant in Pakistan](https://codeatoms.ai/steam-turbine-condition-monitoring-pakistan/): How we designed a steam turbine condition monitoring system for a combined cycle plant in Pakistan, from one-way OPC UA reads to alerts. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23365092.
  - [Object model as JSON](https://codeatoms.ai/steam-turbine-condition-monitoring-pakistan/ontology/objects.json)
- [Corridor Guard: Validated DC Interference Assessment and Mitigation for Every Gas Pipeline Near the Electrode Station](https://codeatoms.ai/dc-interference-gas-pipelines-pakistan/): An open reference architecture for a validation-first DC interference study on buried gas pipelines near a high-voltage direct current electrode station in Pakistan, in oil and gas: a fifteen-object provenance-carrying register, one Apache-2.0 document parser, validated interference modelling, three gated phases, and a re-runnable model handed over on the operator's own 48 GB inference host. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23308093.
  - [Object model as JSON](https://codeatoms.ai/dc-interference-gas-pipelines-pakistan/ontology/objects.json)
- [Hangar Form Cell: Dieless Robotic Sheet Metal From CAD to Certified Part Without Vendor Cloud](https://codeatoms.ai/dieless-sheet-metal-cell-aerospace-mro-us/): An open reference architecture for a dieless robotic sheet metal cell at an aircraft maintenance, repair and overhaul facility in the United States, in aviation and aerospace manufacturing: dual-arm synchronized forming with generic styli, an offline CAD-to-path and springback compensation stack, in-process metrology, a fourteen-object Asset Administration Shell record per serialized part, two Apache-2.0 models on a cell edge box, and an eight-card 48 GB inference server behind a hardware data diode. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23308095.
  - [Object model as JSON](https://codeatoms.ai/dieless-sheet-metal-cell-aerospace-mro-us/ontology/objects.json)
- [Pit Camera Watch: An On-Premises Camera Monitoring System for Every Turn, Crossing and Pit Entry on the Test Site](https://codeatoms.ai/test-site-camera-monitoring-us/): An open reference architecture for a fully on-premises camera monitoring system at a vehicle proving ground in the United States, in discrete manufacturing and automotive: 40 to 60 poles of fixed thermal and visible camera heads on new underground single-mode fiber, an N+1 recorder pair holding 30 days of footage, a four-display operator booth, a fifteen-object ontology, and one Apache-2.0 detector on a 48 GB inference card, with camera uptime as the acceptance metric. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23296077.
  - [Object model as JSON](https://codeatoms.ai/test-site-camera-monitoring-us/ontology/objects.json)
- [Field Ledger: An Open Source Agriculture Data Dashboard the Operator Fully Owns](https://codeatoms.ai/farm-data-dashboard-pakistan/): An open reference architecture for an ontology-anchored, open-source agriculture data dashboard for an agriculture and earth observation operator in Pakistan: site sensor feeds, historical datasets and a big data and analytics repository joined into a twelve-object model in PostgreSQL with PostGIS on the operator's own servers, handed over with source code and full intellectual property. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23186671.
  - [Object model as JSON](https://codeatoms.ai/farm-data-dashboard-pakistan/ontology/objects.json)
- [Fodder Watch: Earth Observation That Turns Restricted-Crop Detections Into Enforceable Case Files](https://codeatoms.ai/restricted-crop-monitoring-saudi-arabia/): An earth observation system design that screens farm parcels with Sentinel-2, Sentinel-1 and Landsat, turns restricted crop detections into enforceable case files, and keeps imagery, weights and detections in the Kingdom. An open reference architecture by CodeNinja Atoms. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23186675.
  - [Object model as JSON](https://codeatoms.ai/restricted-crop-monitoring-saudi-arabia/ontology/objects.json)
- [Baseline: One Flight of 4 Band Orthoimagery and LiDAR for Vegetation Mapping](https://codeatoms.ai/vegetation-mapping-lidar-us/): An earth observation system design for one summer flight of 3-inch 4 band orthoimagery and Quality Level 1 LiDAR, with every tile, point cloud and elevation model bound into a site ontology the operator's own analysts work in the GIS they already run, so the next season starts from a comparison. An open reference architecture by CodeNinja Atoms. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23186673.
  - [Object model as JSON](https://codeatoms.ai/vegetation-mapping-lidar-us/ontology/objects.json)
- [Grid Context Watch: One system of context for OT Security and NERC CIP Evidence](https://codeatoms.ai/ot-security-cip-evidence-us/): OT security monitoring and NERC CIP audit evidence for a US utility on one system of context: passive, one way out of the control networks, on the operator's own hardware. An open reference architecture by CodeNinja Atoms. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23157957.
  - [Object model as JSON](https://codeatoms.ai/ot-security-cip-evidence-us/ontology/objects.json)
- [Reliability Atlas: A Plant Reliability Assessment Study the Operator Can Audit](https://codeatoms.ai/plant-reliability-assessment-saudi-arabia/): An open reference architecture for a records-based reliability and availability assessment across the desalination and treatment plants of an energy and utilities operator in Saudi Arabia: three record sources joined into a thirteen-object reliability model the operator owns, auditable to ISO 55000, with no model to serve and no hardware to buy. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23157965.
  - [Object model as JSON](https://codeatoms.ai/plant-reliability-assessment-saudi-arabia/ontology/objects.json)
- [Loop Integrity Watch: Ending Distorted Radar Level Readings and Tank-to-Tank Swapping Across the Tank Farm](https://codeatoms.ai/tank-gauge-integrity-pakistan/): An open reference architecture that restores continuous, undistorted radar tank gauge readings from thirteen fuel tanks at an oil and gas operator in Pakistan: three booster installations engineered from a signal survey on three Modbus loops, and a governed fifteen-object inventory ontology on the operator's own server that detects distortion and swapping. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23157967.
  - [Object model as JSON](https://codeatoms.ai/tank-gauge-integrity-pakistan/ontology/objects.json)
- [Factory Fire Watch: Read-Only Smart Fire Protection Monitoring for Every High-Risk Factory](https://codeatoms.ai/factory-fire-monitoring-saudi-arabia/): An open reference architecture for read-only fire protection monitoring across high-risk factories in industrial cities in Saudi Arabia: fire alarm panels, fire pumps, fire water tanks and energy meters read through LoRaWAN and contacts into an IoT platform hosted in Saudi Arabia, a fourteen-object ontology, a CPU-only forecaster, and never a write path into life-safety equipment. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23126565.
  - [Object model as JSON](https://codeatoms.ai/factory-fire-monitoring-saudi-arabia/ontology/objects.json)
- [Port Twin: One Governed Digital Twin for Every Asset, Feed and Dollar](https://codeatoms.ai/port-digital-twin-us/): An open reference architecture for a port-owned digital twin at a landlord port authority in the United States: eight operational systems, five live sensor feeds and one finance backbone bound into a thirteen-object ontology on the port's own virtual machines inside the continental United States, with one self-hosted embedding model and no equipment to buy. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23126431.
  - [Object model as JSON](https://codeatoms.ai/port-digital-twin-us/ontology/objects.json)
- [Steel Count Ledger: Independently Counted Production for Every Steel Mill in Pakistan](https://codeatoms.ai/steel-production-count-pakistan/): An open reference architecture for independent production counting at steel melting and re-rolling mills in Pakistan: cameras and GPU industrial PCs at every installation point count billets, ingots, rebars and girders, publish into one operator-owned record, and let revenue officers reconcile counted against declared production, with a fourteen-object ontology, a frontier model behind an export licence checkpoint, and a three-year cost comparison. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23126563.
  - [Object model as JSON](https://codeatoms.ai/steel-production-count-pakistan/ontology/objects.json)
- [Structure Phase Watch: Live Production, Crane and Delivery Evidence for Every Pour on a Construction Site](https://codeatoms.ai/structure-phase-construction-saudi-arabia/): A construction progress monitoring system design that joins precast production, crane utilisation and truck flow into one live model of the structure phase, forecasts schedule slips three days out and shows safety breaches as they happen, on the contractor's own hardware in the Kingdom. An open reference architecture by CodeNinja Atoms. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23126448.
  - [Object model as JSON](https://codeatoms.ai/structure-phase-construction-saudi-arabia/ontology/objects.json)
- [Sovereign HSE Watch: A Reference Architecture for Predictive Health, Safety and Environment Intelligence in Pakistan's Oil and Gas Operations](https://codeatoms.ai/sovereign-hse-pakistan/): An open reference architecture for a sovereign, air-gapped HSE platform for an oil and gas operator in Pakistan: eight source systems, a twelve-object ontology, six self-hosted open-weight models on one GPU node, and a three-year cost comparison against cloud. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23119714.
  - [Object model as JSON](https://codeatoms.ai/sovereign-hse-pakistan/ontology/objects.json)
- [Terminal Pulse: Predicted Truck Turn Time and Live Yard Sight for a Container Terminal](https://codeatoms.ai/truck-turn-container-terminal-us/): An open reference architecture for predicting truck turn time two hours out and seeing yard congestion live at a container terminal in the United States: eleven source systems, a twelve-object ontology, edge vision at the yard and gate, a frontier model on the operator's own hardware, and a three-year cost comparison against cloud. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23159331.
  - [Object model as JSON](https://codeatoms.ai/truck-turn-container-terminal-us/ontology/objects.json)
- [Feeder Firewatch: Live Ignition and Outage Risk for Every Distribution Feeder](https://codeatoms.ai/wildfire-risk-distribution-us/): An open reference architecture for live wildfire ignition and outage risk at an electric distribution cooperative in the United States: twelve source systems, a fourteen-object ontology, self-hosted open-weight models on the cooperative's own hardware, every de-energisation approved by a named operator, and a three-year cost comparison against cloud. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23159328.
  - [Object model as JSON](https://codeatoms.ai/wildfire-risk-distribution-us/ontology/objects.json)

## Memos

- [Compression and Reinflation](https://codeatoms.ai/memos/compression-and-reinflation/): Why we do not fine tune, and how we build physical AI systems that get better when the next model arrives A memo by Umar Bilal, 2026-10-10. Markdown: https://codeatoms.ai/memos/compression-and-reinflation/index.md

## Engineering blog

- [Physical AI System Design for Warehousing and Intralogistics: What the Published Designs Already Answer](https://codeatoms.ai/blog/physical-ai-system-design-for-warehousing/): No warehousing design has been published in this series yet. Nine of the eighteen open reference architectures already answer the questions a warehouse or distribution center asks first: one picture of the operation from the systems it already runs, dock and yard turn time, people and vehicles seen on camera, fleet and fixed equipment condition, fire and life safety, counting what leaves, and what a records only study can settle before any sensor is bought. By CodeNinja Atoms, 2026-10-16. Markdown: https://codeatoms.ai/blog/physical-ai-system-design-for-warehousing/index.md
- [Physical AI System Design for Mining: What the Published Designs Already Answer](https://codeatoms.ai/blog/physical-ai-system-design-for-mining/): No mining design has been published in this series yet. Eight of the eighteen open reference architectures already answer the questions a mine asks first: people and vehicles on haul roads, mobile fleet and fixed plant condition, incidents before they happen, fire and life safety, counting what leaves the plant, and what a records-only study can settle before any sensor is bought. By CodeNinja Atoms, 2026-10-15. Markdown: https://codeatoms.ai/blog/physical-ai-system-design-for-mining/index.md
- [From a CISA Advisory to a Closed Finding](https://codeatoms.ai/blog/from-a-cisa-advisory-to-a-closed-finding/): What an operational technology security team does with an advisory about an actively exploited vulnerability, traced through one published system of context: the advisory becomes a threat intelligence item, the item seeds detection rules, a finding scores the operator's own assets, a named analyst accepts or rejects the risk, and the evidence a NERC CIP audit asks for is assembled on the way. By CodeNinja Atoms, 2026-10-14. Markdown: https://codeatoms.ai/blog/from-a-cisa-advisory-to-a-closed-finding/index.md
- [The Model Register Across Sixteen Designs](https://codeatoms.ai/blog/the-model-register-across-sixteen-designs/): Sixteen open reference architectures for physical operations, each with a model register the operator owns outright. Twelve models, four empty registers by decision, and one licence pattern that repeats in every design. By CodeNinja Atoms, 2026-10-13. Markdown: https://codeatoms.ai/blog/the-model-register-across-sixteen-designs/index.md
- [Sensing Comes Before the Model](https://codeatoms.ai/blog/sensing-comes-before-the-model/): Three published earth observation architectures decide what to watch from law, revisit and ownership, never from model accuracy. Two of the three ship with an empty model register. By CodeNinja Atoms, 2026-10-11. Markdown: https://codeatoms.ai/blog/sensing-comes-before-the-model/index.md
- [Own or Rent the GPUs](https://codeatoms.ai/blog/own-or-rent-the-gpus/): Seven published reference architectures, priced the same way, say owning the reasoning node costs between about half and nearly all of the deepest three year cloud commitment. Not a tenth. By CodeNinja Atoms, 2026-10-10. Markdown: https://codeatoms.ai/blog/own-or-rent-the-gpus/index.md
- [Don't Baptize the GPUs](https://codeatoms.ai/blog/dont-baptize-the-gpus/): Why AI systems should be measured by running them, trained to seek truth and owned by the organizations that depend on them, rather than blessed into a theological category. By Umar Bilal, 2026-10-06. Markdown: https://codeatoms.ai/blog/dont-baptize-the-gpus/index.md

## Co-build an ontology for your operation

- [Co-build](https://codeatoms.ai/co-build/): CodeNinja Atoms designs the physical AI system for one of your operations and writes the operation as an object model you own, in the hyper-ontology/1 package format. One form, 13 sectors. Markdown: https://codeatoms.ai/co-build/index.md
- [Co-build: agriculture and earth observation](https://codeatoms.ai/co-build/agriculture-and-earth-observation/)
